label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_02
text: 我听说～你成为\n蓝莓联盟的冠军了啊！？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_03
text: 哎呀～好厉害啊！\c\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你能来\n真是太好啦！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_04
text:
你来这里已经
有一段时间了。\c
在蓝莓学园
过得还开心吗？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_01
text: 开心！

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_02
text: 一般吧

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_05
text: 好呀，好呀，\n正正好呀～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_06
text: 哦～一般啊。\n你的意思就是说“一般都很开心”，对吧！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_07
text: 既然如此，我有一件事\n想恳请[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你帮忙……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_08
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你来到\n蓝莓学园以后，托你的福，\r\n学园上下都变得特别有活力啦。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_09
text: 今后我想更积极地\n从帕底亚地区邀请\r\n各种各样的人来当[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]特邀教员[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_10
text: ……你好像人脉很广，\n朋友也很多吧？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_11
text: 像是学校的老师，道馆馆主，\n或是很～强的朋友！\r\n如果有合适人选，就邀请到学园来吧～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_03
text: 交给我吧！

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_12
text: 不愧是冠军！\n真可靠呀！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_13
text: 不愧是冠军！\n已经在烦恼该叫谁了呀！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_14
text: 从社团活动室的电脑\n试着联系想邀请的人吧。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_system_01
text: 支付交通费之类的会需要ＢＰ，\n我就先付给你啦。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_15
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从席蓝校长那里\n获得了２００ＢＰ！

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_16
text: 我会让请来的特邀教员\n在这间社团活动室待机，\r\n你就借机加深和对方的友谊吧。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_17
text: 那就交给你啦～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
